title: Berezina, Eighteen Twelve: The Pontoniers Who Built Bridges in an Icy River
summary: This episode tells how Napoleon's Grande Armée, retreating from Moscow in November eighteen twelve, was trapped between three Russian armies and still crossed the Berezina River. At its center are the tools General Eblé secretly kept from the bridging equipment he had been ordered to burn, and the roughly four hundred pontoniers, most of them Dutch, who waded into the icy water at Studianka and built two bridges. The story runs from the fake crossing to the south that fooled the Russians to the burning of the bridges on the morning of November twenty-ninth, the thousands of people left on the far bank, and the phrase c'est
